acceptance_predicates.description: Provisional, committed, stale, superseded, and unavailable revision states have typed stable meanings and no ambiguous fallback.
Older catalog/channel/provider/model/source revisions are rejected before launch, capture, or replay and cannot overwrite a newer committed state.
Wizard edits, cancellation, restart, launch, capture, replay, and comparison preserve the exact committed revision or expose a typed diagnostic.
The executable formal UI model and source inventory bind every declared revision transition and every user-facing route in both directions.
Current-main formal model, source-parity, transition/property, and hosted quality gates pass without threshold or module-inventory weakening.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain warning-only and never block local/mock qualification.

definition_of_done: Focused provisional/stale/supersession tests pass at exact current TUI main.
Formal model/source parity and protected hosted gates pass at the same head.
A signed privacy-safe receipt records the exact revision and gate evidence.

inputs.description: Selection-driven TUI wizard and persisted provider/model/channel state.
Catalog, channel manifest, provider/model discovery, and source/build revisions.

outputs.description: Stable lifecycle state and diagnostics consumed by wizard and handoff routes.
Exact-head formal parity and provisional/stale qualification evidence.

gates.description: No stale or superseded revision can reach execution or replace newer state.
Formal model and executable source inventories remain equal and fully covered.
